definitions.explanation: The sport of racing horses, typically with betting. In Japan, this is a popular form of legalized gambling.

examples.japanese: {競馬|けいば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}に→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to watch horse racing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{競馬|けいば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賭|か}けている→賭ける：noentry⟧。
examples.english: My father bets on horse racing every week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{競馬|けいば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}に→世界的：noentry⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧で、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦レース→レース：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}くの→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese horse racing is famous worldwide, and large races attract many spectators.

notes:
{競馬|けいば} refers to the sport of horse racing. In Japan, it is one of the few forms of legal gambling alongside {競輪|けいりん} (bicycle racing), {競艇|きょうてい} (boat racing), and オートレース (motorcycle racing).

Common collocations:
- {競馬|けいば}を{見|み}る (to watch horse racing)
- {競馬|けいば}に{賭|か}ける (to bet on horse racing)
- {競馬場|けいばじょう} (racetrack)
- {競馬|けいば}ファン (horse racing fan)

Cultural note: Major races like the {日本|にっぽん}ダービー and the {有馬記念|ありまきねん} draw huge audiences and significant betting pools.
